notes: DiscoFlate v3.43.0 — the consolidation finale (config v10). EVERYTHING is an action block now: commands and timed events lose their legacy type dropdowns (a command is its gates + an action block; minigames keep their tiers), replies and per-action announce boxes are gone — the bot speaks only through message rows, with roll/fire/award results flowing into later rows as placeholders. New chance action (odds + nested win/miss blocks) and stop_devices action. command_gate gets Block/Allow/Resume pills over commands AND events (block one event, pause all timed or all capacity events). The builtin !agroll chat command is now a plain custom command (range dice + luck still rule). Competitions are fully button-driven (entry command removed). Timed-event rounds run detached so a wait/poll never stalls the session. Templates moved to System. Everything auto-migrates, presets and templates included.
